# Paired mapper collector

This independently authored fixture binds three method formals through two
binary mapper inputs and a three-slot result containing an invariant pair.
Source and dependency profiles recover the same original call sites. An entry
also calls the standard library collector factory; only the owned observer
executes the standard library collection operation.

The provider returns an opaque, replaceable bucket and may skip either mapper.
The observer checks retained arguments and source snapshots, callback and action
order, aliases, nulls, return casts, ignored calls and exact exception objects.
It checks the standard factory creates no early callbacks and preserves map
contents and callback failures. Independent wrong programs must fail before
recovery. Signature-only controls retain every original Code attribute.
